claims.statement: Watson Brake’s mound builders: approximately 3500–2800 BCE.
Watson Brake has eleven mounds and connecting ridges. Building was episodic. Food remains include nuts, fish and deer and indicate broad-spectrum foraging.

evidence.note: The displayed 3500–2800 BCE site range follows 64 Parishes. Saunders and colleagues date substantial mound raising from about 3350 BCE until after 3000 BCE; work was episodic.
